name: SnugBox
definition: A precise algorithm for computing Gaussian-tile bounding box intersections, replacing the overly conservative tile assignment in standard 3D-GS to reduce the number of pixels processed per Gaussian.
summary: SnugBox is a plug-and-play optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting that computes tight axis-aligned bounding boxes from elliptical extents to accelerate rendering without altering the image.
